title: The three shapes where the negative direction is also cheap
statement: (1) Univariate nonnegativity on an interval: sum-of-squares is complete (Markov-Lukacs), the certificate is exact rational. (2) SDP infeasibility: one rational dual ray. (3) Small pure-SAT instances: DRAT falls out of a proof-producing CDCL core for free. Reject any target that fits none of these unless you only want the positive direction.
